'''Meta''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who served as a [[commodore]] in the [[Resistance]] during its [[Cold War|conflict]] with the [[First Order]]. She was stationed at the [[Resistance base]] on [[D'Qar]] during the [[Battle of Starkiller Base]].<ref name="Episode VII" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Meta is portrayed by [[Morgan Dameron]] in the [[2015]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[sequel trilogy]].<ref name="Episode VII" />
